messages.subject: how to have a single checkboxGroupInput() that selects multiple inputs
parts:
Hello all,

I have a checkboxGroupInput() that I want to be able to select or de-select the integers (0-9), but I would like for their to be only one checkbox labeled "numbers" instead of 10 separate boxes. Is this possible?

Thanks,
